_comment: The black slab a title is set on, shared by the channels that use one.
Named rather than repeated per channel because it is one design, not
two that happen to match — a change to the border or the shadow is
meant to reach both, and two copies would drift the first time only
The shadow falls straight down, with no sideways offset, because the
panel sits hard against one side of the frame: with the block on the
right, a shadow offset to the right ran off the canvas and was clipped
along its whole edge — the slab stopped reading as lifted on exactly
the side you look at first. Straight down is the one direction that
survives the block being on either side.
